videoUrl.title: YouTube video URL
videoUrl.description: Supports watch?v=, youtu.be/, and shorts/ URL formats.

strategy.title: Extraction strategy
strategy.description: auto: tries direct HTTP fetch first (fastest, no subprocess), falls back to yt-dlp. direct: direct only. ytdlp: yt-dlp only (most compatible).

preferredLanguage.title: Preferred transcript languages (ordered)
preferredLanguage.description: Ordered list of language codes to prefer, e.g. ["en", "en-US"]. Defaults to English if omitted.

languagePreference.title: Preferred transcript languages (legacy alias)
languagePreference.description: Legacy alias for preferredLanguage. Use preferredLanguage instead.

removeBrackets.title: Remove bracketed non-speech markers
removeBrackets.description: Remove annotations like [Music] or [Applause] from the transcript text.

joinWith.title: Join transcript segments with
joinWith.description: Character used to join individual transcript segments: space or newline.

paragraphMode.title: Paragraph mode
paragraphMode.description: Groups segments into paragraphs based on silence gaps. Outputs double-newline between paragraphs.

paragraphBreakSecs.title: Paragraph break threshold (seconds)
paragraphBreakSecs.description: Minimum silence gap in seconds that triggers a new paragraph when paragraphMode is true.

outputMode.title: Output mode
outputMode.description: text_only returns transcriptText only. text_and_segments also includes the segments array with per-cue timing data.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: text returns plain transcript. srt also adds a srtContent field with numbered subtitle blocks and timestamps.

includeStats.title: Include transcript statistics
includeStats.description: Adds a stats object with wordCount, charCount, segmentCount, coveredSec, wordsPerMinute, and estimatedReadingTimeSec.

proxyMode.title: Proxy mode
proxyMode.description: Proxy configuration: off disables proxies, auto tries datacenter then residential, datacenter uses Apify datacenter proxies, residential uses residential proxies.

debug.title: Debug logging
debug.description: Enables verbose logging of yt-dlp commands, strategy attempts, and proxy usage.

saveVttToKV.title: Save raw VTT to Key-Value Store
saveVttToKV.description: Saves the raw VTT caption file to the Apify Key-Value Store. Output includes vttKvKey and vttFilename fields.

enableWhisper.title: Enable Whisper fallback (currently disabled)
enableWhisper.description: Reserved for future Whisper AI transcription fallback. Currently has no effect.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per strategy/proxy combination
maxRetries.description: Number of times to retry each strategy and proxy combination before moving to the next.

timeoutMs.title: Total timeout (ms)
timeoutMs.description: Maximum time in milliseconds for the entire extraction process. Defaults to 180000 (3 minutes).

timeoutSecs.title: Total timeout (seconds, optional alias)
timeoutSecs.description: Optional alias for timeoutMs expressed in seconds. Ignored if timeoutMs is also set.
